summary: performance lens over assistant-governed-ask (20 product path(s), 99626df..b3c8a3a, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 4 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The core route registration and governance changes are present, but conversation IDs are not consistently rejected with a typed 400, several durable-conversation compatibility leftovers remain despite the blocking no-leftovers rule, and common greetings now incur the semantic/LLM path instead of deterministic handling.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Reject conversationId before entering the streaming callback (backend/src/chat/chat.schemas.ts:18): `conversationId` remains valid under this schema.

[P1] Remove the unused durable-conversations service dependency (backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:54): The durable conversation reads and writes were deleted, but `ConversationsService` remains injected as `_conversations` and is also instantiated through `ChatModule`.

[P1] Remove the accepted-but-ignored turnId compatibility input (backend/src/chat/chat.schemas.ts:19): The public schema still accepts `turnId`, the controller forwards it, and the service merely renames it `_turnId` without using it.
[P1] Remove the newly introduced deprecated compatibility marker (contract/src/api.ts:133): The change explicitly introduces an `@deprecated` comment for `conversationId`.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Keep ordinary greeting phrases on the deterministic path (backend/src/chat/smalltalk-guard.ts:63): Replacing the prior short greeting-prefix match with exact set membership means inputs such as `hello there` and `hey team` no longer classify as general chat.
